scope: R3-011 Evidence Graph admission of current R3-007 verification evidence
hypothesis: The historical Evidence Graph adapter can incorrectly promote structurally incomplete or proxy R3-007 evidence to FATTO and can expose explicit edges from non-factual records as promotion support. A bounded fail-closed patch can remove those false admissions while preserving valid authoritative match and mismatch evidence.
falsifiers: AUTHORITATIVE match without a nonempty postcondition_source is stored as FATTO
PROXY mismatch is stored as FATTO or AUTHORITATIVE_STATE
an EXPLICIT support/test edge sourced from an IPOTESI record enters promotion_support
unknown epistemic, evidence, relation or basis enum values are accepted
a valid current R3-007 authoritative match or mismatch stops being representable
the patch creates a second verifier instead of adapting the existing R3-007 evidence contract

experiment.baseline: Recover only the historical R3-011 module/tests and execute the frozen malformed/proxy/nonfactual controls before patching.
experiment.trial: Add runtime enum validation, strict current R3-007 evidence-shape validation, consistency checks and factual-source filtering for promotion support.
experiment.acceptance: All frozen false-admission controls are refused or remain non-factual; valid authoritative match and mismatch remain FATTO; historical tests and relevant R3-007/R3-020 tests pass.
experiment.candidate_boundary: isolated local branch; no push, merge, deploy or canonical queue update

limits: The test validates deterministic evidence admission, not truth of an external source.
A syntactically valid source label still does not prove domain authority.
Local tests do not substitute for hosted review or adoption.
